title: Grateful Dead Live at Ventura County Fairgrounds on 1982-07-17
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > R8Brain SRC > Wavelab (adding 16-bit patch) > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 09/2016
source: Set 2 AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90, FOB recording by Brian Schley.

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording of a high‑energy first California show, praised for its clear sound despite windy conditions.
ai_review.review: The tape is lauded as an “amazing” capture that cuts through the wind at Ventura, delivering crystal‑clear audio that ranks with the best of this taper team. While no specific songs are highlighted, the reviewer’s excitement about their first West Coast show conveys a high‑energy performance worth hearing.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong positive feedback on recording quality and overall excitement of the show outweighs minimal commentary from the second review.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, balanced sound despite wind blowing around the fairgrounds; reviewer notes it sounds as good as any other tape from this team.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on song sequence; focus is on overall excitement of the concert.
